Earlier, multiple backend code changes showed that Apple was adding Car Keys functionality to Tank brand vehicles under Great Wall Motors (GWM); now it appears Apple is preparing to extend this feature to another brand under the same automaker. Details below.

According to reports, the Car Keys feature in Apple Wallet will support Haval vehicles

A few weeks ago, Apple added related code references in the backend, indicating that Tank brand vehicles under Great Wall Motors would soon support the CarKeys feature in Apple Wallet. This feature allows users to lock, unlock, and start compatible vehicles using an iPhone or Apple Watch.

Now, based on a discovery by Aaron Perris on X, similar code references have also appeared for Haval—another brand under the same Chinese automaker:

Although some Haval models under Great Wall Motors already offer CarPlay, none currently support Apple's standalone Car Keys feature.

Once officially launched, compatible Haval models will join the existing list of over 50 car models that support Car Keys, including brands such as BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Hyundai, Kia, Genesis, Toyota, and Rivian.

Click here to learn more about the Car Keys feature in Apple Wallet and view the full list of compatible vehicles.
